entries.en: She imbibed a love of storytelling from her grandfather.
entries.zh: 她从祖父那里受到熏陶，爱上了讲故事。

entries.meaningZh: 把不想要的东西强加于
entries.en: They foisted the unwanted cleaning duties on their newest colleague.
entries.zh: 他们把没人愿意做的清洁工作强加给了最新来的同事。

entries.en: The old chronicle describes a town devastated by pestilence.
entries.zh: 这部古老的编年史描述了一座被瘟疫摧残的城镇。

entries.en: The magician used sleight of hand to hide the coin.
entries.zh: 魔术师用巧妙的手法藏起了硬币。

entries.en: His facetious reply annoyed colleagues who wanted a serious answer.
entries.zh: 同事们想要认真的答复，他那不合时宜的玩笑话让他们恼火。

entries.en: The abandoned puppy gave us a doleful look.
entries.zh: 那只被遗弃的小狗悲伤地望着我们。

entries.en: The tourists decamped when rain swept across the campsite.
entries.zh: 雨水席卷营地时，游客们匆匆离开了。

entries.en: He grew sulky after losing the board game.
entries.zh: 棋盘游戏输了以后，他就生起了闷气。

entries.en: A sonorous voice announced the beginning of the ceremony.
entries.zh: 一个浑厚响亮的声音宣布仪式开始。

entries.en: I felt rather obtuse when everyone else understood the joke.
entries.zh: 其他人都听懂了那个笑话，我觉得自己有些迟钝。

entries.en: Her jocular tone helped everyone relax before the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练前，她诙谐的语气让大家都放松了下来。

entries.en: The seminar encouraged open discussion rather than dogmatism.
entries.zh: 这次研讨会鼓励开放讨论，而不是拘泥教条。

entries.en: A deep snowdrift blocked the gate to our garden.
entries.zh: 一堆被风吹积起来的厚雪堵住了花园大门。

entries.en: The boatbuilder caulked the gaps between the wooden planks.
entries.zh: 造船工填好了木板之间的缝隙，以防渗漏。

entries.en: We stood with our mouths agape as the curtain rose.
entries.zh: 帷幕升起时，我们惊讶得张大了嘴。

entries.en: This lightweight scarf is made from rayon rather than silk.
entries.zh: 这条轻薄的围巾是人造丝制成的，并非真丝。

entries.en: A cavalcade of vintage cars passed through the village.
entries.zh: 一队老爷车驶过了村庄。

entries.en: A small bird warbled outside my window at dawn.
entries.zh: 黎明时，一只小鸟在我的窗外婉转鸣唱。

entries.en: The historical painting depicts mourners gathered around a funeral pyre.
entries.zh: 这幅历史画描绘了哀悼者围聚在火葬柴堆旁的情景。

entries.en: Her course in thermodynamics includes a project about heat engines.
entries.zh: 她的热力学课程包含一个关于热机的项目。

entries.en: His constant boasting became insufferable during the long journey.
entries.zh: 漫长的旅途中，他不停地吹嘘，令人无法忍受。

entries.en: The museum displays a lump of naturally occurring bitumen.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一块天然形成的沥青。

entries.en: The animation shows the gas liquefying as its temperature falls.
entries.zh: 动画展示了气体随温度下降而液化的过程。

entries.en: I borrowed a ballpoint to complete the visitor form.
entries.zh: 我借了一支圆珠笔填写访客表。

entries.en: The school recognized her meritorious service to the debating club.
entries.zh: 学校表彰了她为辩论社作出的贡献。

entries.en: The quilter arranged tiny fabric squares into a star pattern.
entries.zh: 这位拼布被制作者把小布方块排成了星形图案。

entries.en: Magnetic repulsion kept the two model cars apart.
entries.zh: 磁斥力使两辆模型车保持着距离。

entries.en: The old granary has become a small village museum.
entries.zh: 那座旧谷仓如今成了一间小小的乡村博物馆。

entries.en: A mockingbird copied several different calls from the fence.
entries.zh: 一只嘲鸫站在篱笆上模仿了几种不同的叫声。

entries.en: We spotted a pronghorn running across the open plain.
entries.zh: 我们看见一只叉角羚奔跑着穿过开阔的平原。

entries.en: The chemistry display includes a model of lactic acid.
entries.zh: 化学展区里有一个乳酸分子模型。

entries.en: The anatomy chart labels several ocular muscles in blue.
entries.zh: 这张解剖图用蓝色标出了几块眼部肌肉。

entries.en: I was remiss in forgetting to thank the volunteers.
entries.zh: 我忘了感谢志愿者，是我疏忽了。

entries.en: Her essay is a paean to the pleasures of walking.
entries.zh: 她的文章是一篇赞美散步乐趣的赞歌。

entries.en: The engineer compared the tensile strength of several different fibers.
entries.zh: 工程师比较了几种不同纤维的抗拉强度。

entries.en: A museum video explains the purpose of cryogenic storage tanks.
entries.zh: 博物馆的一段视频解释了低温储罐的用途。

entries.en: The young firebrand challenged the committee at every meeting.
entries.zh: 那个年轻的激进分子每次开会都挑战委员会。

entries.en: The understudy performed brilliantly when the lead actor fell ill.
entries.zh: 主演生病后，替补演员的演出十分精彩。

entries.en: The underutilized courtyard could host our weekly art workshops.
entries.zh: 这个未充分利用的庭院可以用来举办每周的艺术工作坊。

entries.en: A thin line of solder joined the metal pieces.
entries.zh: 一条细细的焊料把那些金属部件连接了起来。

entries.en: The label describes this clear liquid as odorless.
entries.zh: 标签上说这种透明液体没有气味。

entries.en: A melodious flute solo drifted through the open doorway.
entries.zh: 一段悦耳的长笛独奏声从敞开的门口传来。

entries.en: This landlocked country has no direct access to the sea.
entries.zh: 这个内陆国家没有直接通往海洋的出口。

entries.en: The fairy tale features an apparently omnipotent wizard.
entries.zh: 这则童话里有一位看似无所不能的巫师。

entries.en: Delicate silver filigree decorated the lid of the box.
entries.zh: 精巧的银丝饰品装点着盒盖。

entries.en: A new creative project rescued her from weekend ennui.
entries.zh: 一个新的创作项目让她摆脱了周末的无聊倦怠。

entries.en: The irascible shopkeeper complained whenever customers moved the chairs.
entries.zh: 只要顾客挪动椅子，那个易怒的店主就会抱怨。

entries.en: Years of rain had effaced the inscription on the stone.
entries.zh: 多年的雨水已磨去了石头上的铭文。

entries.en: She apologized for the impertinence of her personal question.
entries.zh: 她为自己问了无礼的私人问题而道歉。

entries.en: The lecture contrasted empiricism with theories based on pure reason.
entries.zh: 这堂课比较了经验主义与基于纯粹理性的理论。

entries.en: The old recipe calls for one gramme of saffron.
entries.zh: 这份老食谱需要一克藏红花。

entries.en: The museum has a nineteenth-century denture in its medical collection.
entries.zh: 这家博物馆的医学藏品中有一副十九世纪的假牙。

entries.en: The workshop uses softwood such as pine for these shelves.
entries.zh: 这家工坊用松木等针叶树木材制作这些架子。

entries.en: They laminated the classroom signs to keep them clean.
entries.zh: 他们给教室里的标牌覆了膜，方便保持清洁。

entries.en: The report underplayed the importance of the volunteers' contribution.
entries.zh: 这份报告淡化了志愿者贡献的重要性。

entries.en: The actor adjusted his cravat before entering the stage.
entries.zh: 演员在上台前整理了一下领巾。

entries.en: Our handball team practices in the sports hall every Tuesday.
entries.zh: 我们的手球队每周二在体育馆训练。

entries.en: His chivalrous gesture seemed slightly old-fashioned but entirely sincere.
entries.zh: 他彬彬有礼的举动显得有些老派，却完全出于真心。

entries.en: Her practical approach challenged the committee's doctrinaire thinking.
entries.zh: 她务实的做法挑战了委员会的教条思维。

entries.en: The appetizing smell of roasted vegetables filled the kitchen.
entries.zh: 烤蔬菜令人垂涎的香味弥漫了厨房。

entries.en: A putrid apple lay forgotten at the bottom of the basket.
entries.zh: 一个腐烂的苹果被遗忘在篮子底部。

entries.en: Fetid water had collected in the abandoned basement.
entries.zh: 废弃的地下室里积满了恶臭的水。

entries.en: The editor spotted a howler in the headline.
entries.zh: 编辑在标题中发现了一处明显而可笑的错误。

entries.en: A beatific smile spread across the sleeping baby's face.
entries.zh: 熟睡的宝宝脸上浮现出幸福安详的笑容。

entries.en: She seemed to learn the local slang by osmosis.
entries.zh: 她似乎在耳濡目染中学会了当地的俚语。

entries.en: The architects tested the concert hall's acoustical properties.
entries.zh: 建筑师们测试了音乐厅的声学性能。

entries.en: Our unflappable host found extra chairs when unexpected guests arrived.
entries.zh: 意外的客人到来时，镇定自若的主人找来了额外的椅子。

entries.en: His sanctimonious lecture about honesty irritated everyone who knew him.
entries.zh: 了解他的人都被他那番假装正直的诚实说教惹恼了。

entries.en: The artist elongated the figures to create a dreamlike effect.
entries.zh: 画家把人物拉长，以营造梦幻般的效果。

entries.en: She dismissed his promises as cant rather than genuine concern.
entries.zh: 她认为他的承诺只是虚伪的空话，并非真正的关心。

entries.en: This exhibition represents the apogee of her artistic career.
entries.zh: 这次展览代表了她艺术生涯的顶峰。

entries.en: The performer spun a lasso above his head.
entries.zh: 表演者在头顶上方转动着套索。

entries.en: She read the farewell message in a tremulous voice.
entries.zh: 她用颤抖的声音读出了告别留言。

entries.en: I tend to procrastinate when a task seems overwhelming.
entries.zh: 任务看起来令人难以应付时，我往往会拖延。

entries.en: A typographical error changed the date on the invitation.
entries.zh: 一处排印错误使请柬上的日期变了。

entries.en: The opening scene prefigures the conflict that dominates the novel.
entries.zh: 开篇的场景预示了贯穿小说的冲突。

entries.en: As a lifelong urbanite, he found the countryside unusually quiet.
entries.zh: 他一生都住在城市，觉得乡村格外安静。

entries.en: The captain refused to tolerate the sailor's insolence.
entries.zh: 船长不肯容忍那个水手的傲慢无礼。

entries.en: A pale aquamarine formed the centerpiece of the necklace.
entries.zh: 一颗浅色的海蓝宝石是这条项链的中心装饰。

entries.en: The villain stepped threateningly toward the door in the play.
entries.zh: 在剧中，反派气势汹汹地朝门口走去。

entries.en: Ducks disappeared into the reedy edges of the pond.
entries.zh: 鸭子消失在池塘边茂密的芦苇丛中。

entries.en: The penitent child returned the toy and offered an apology.
entries.zh: 那个悔过的孩子归还了玩具，并道了歉。

entries.en: The jeweler examined the gemstone under a bright lamp.
entries.zh: 珠宝商在明亮的灯下检查那颗宝石。

entries.en: The machine extrudes clay into long, hollow tubes.
entries.zh: 机器把黏土挤压成细长的空心管。

entries.en: The debonair presenter greeted the audience with an easy smile.
entries.zh: 那位潇洒优雅的主持人从容地微笑着向观众致意。

entries.en: The hens hurried back to their coop at dusk.
entries.zh: 黄昏时，母鸡们匆匆回到了鸡舍。

entries.en: The tardy guest slipped quietly into the back row.
entries.zh: 那位迟到的客人悄悄坐进了后排。

entries.en: His bellicose tone turned a minor disagreement into an argument.
entries.zh: 他好斗的语气让一场小小的分歧变成了争吵。

entries.en: She thought it politic to thank both competing teams.
entries.zh: 她认为感谢两支竞争队伍是明智圆通的做法。

entries.en: The portrait shows a swarthy sailor beside a fishing boat.
entries.zh: 这幅肖像画描绘了一位站在渔船旁、肤色黝黑的水手。

entries.en: Her winsome smile won over even the grumpiest visitor.
entries.zh: 她讨人喜欢的笑容连脾气最差的访客都打动了。

entries.en: Refraction makes the straw appear bent inside the glass.
entries.zh: 折射使玻璃杯里的吸管看起来弯了。

entries.en: The diagram shows the epidermis above the deeper skin layers.
entries.zh: 图中显示，表皮位于皮肤较深层的上方。

entries.en: The willowy dancer moved lightly across the rehearsal room.
entries.zh: 那位苗条优雅的舞者轻盈地穿过排练室。

entries.en: The tale describes a comely stranger arriving at the castle.
entries.zh: 故事描写了一位容貌清秀的陌生人来到城堡。

entries.en: The maritime museum has an exhibit about scurvy among sailors.
entries.zh: 海事博物馆有一个关于水手坏血病的展区。

entries.en: Our team outmaneuvered its opponents with an unexpected change of formation.
entries.zh: 我们队出人意料地变换阵形，以策略战胜了对手。

entries.en: Her interest in aeronautics began with building model airplanes.
entries.zh: 她对航空学的兴趣始于制作飞机模型。

entries.en: The washroom is just beyond the museum gift shop.
entries.zh: 洗手间就在博物馆礼品店的另一边。

entries.en: His imitation of the headmaster produced a tremendous guffaw.
entries.zh: 他对校长的模仿引来了一阵哄然大笑。

entries.en: Her prissy objections took some fun out of the picnic.
entries.zh: 她拘谨又挑剔的反对意见让野餐少了几分乐趣。

entries.en: Pleasant drowsiness gradually settled over us in the warm afternoon.
entries.zh: 在温暖的午后，一阵惬意的困意渐渐向我们袭来。

entries.en: The breeze tousled her hair as she crossed the bridge.
entries.zh: 她走过桥时，微风吹乱了她的头发。

entries.en: The textbook uses purple shading to identify glandular tissue.
entries.zh: 课本用紫色阴影标示腺体组织。

entries.en: A wooden stockade surrounded the reconstructed settlement.
entries.zh: 一道木桩围栏环绕着这个重建的聚落。

entries.en: The young artist rented a garret above the bakery.
entries.zh: 那位年轻艺术家租下了面包店楼上的阁楼小屋。

entries.en: The poet returned to her natal village after many years.
entries.zh: 多年以后，诗人回到了她出生的村庄。

entries.en: Repeated tardiness disrupted the start of our rehearsals.
entries.zh: 一再有人迟到，打乱了我们排练开始时的安排。

entries.en: She offered profuse apologies for spilling paint on the carpet.
entries.zh: 她为把颜料洒在地毯上而连连道歉。

entries.en: The lever balanced perfectly on its central fulcrum.
entries.zh: 这根杠杆在中央支点上保持着完美平衡。

entries.en: Sunlight revealed the intricate pattern of the parquet.
entries.zh: 阳光照出了镶木地板精细的图案。

entries.en: A hyphen joins the two parts of her surname.
entries.zh: 一个连字符把她姓氏的两部分连接起来。

entries.en: The reunion became maudlin after everyone started recalling old disappointments.
entries.zh: 大家开始回忆过去的失意之后，聚会变得过分伤感。

entries.en: The critic delivered a pitiless assessment of the performance.
entries.zh: 评论家对这场演出作出了毫不留情的评价。

entries.en: The medical history display includes an old chart about jaundice.
entries.zh: 医学史展区里有一张关于黄疸的旧图表。

entries.en: Once a laggard in the class, she now leads every discussion.
entries.zh: 她曾是班里的落后者，如今却在每次讨论中引领大家。

entries.en: Unlike the nocturnal owl, this diurnal bird feeds during daylight.
entries.zh: 与那只夜行的猫头鹰不同，这只昼间活动的鸟在白天觅食。

entries.en: Before we leave, let me recapitulate the main decisions.
entries.zh: 离开之前，让我重述一下主要决定。

entries.en: He is punctilious about crediting every contributor to the project.
entries.zh: 他在为项目的每一位贡献者署名方面一丝不苟。

entries.en: Her remark was particularly apropos during our discussion of fairness.
entries.zh: 我们讨论公平问题时，她的那番话格外切题。

entries.en: The novel depicts the family's descent from comfort into destitution.
entries.zh: 小说描写了这个家庭从安逸跌入赤贫的过程。

entries.en: The last bather emerged from the lake at sunset.
entries.zh: 日落时，最后一位游泳者从湖里上了岸。

entries.en: The portrait captured the farmer's wizened face in remarkable detail.
entries.zh: 这幅肖像细致入微地描绘了农夫干瘪多皱的脸。

entries.en: She unfastened the clasp and lifted the necklace from its box.
entries.zh: 她解开搭扣，从盒子里拿出了项链。

entries.en: In the comedy, a raccoon pilfers snacks from an unwatched picnic.
entries.zh: 在这部喜剧里，一只浣熊从无人看守的野餐处偷取零食。

entries.en: The puzzle asks for an anagram of the word below.
entries.zh: 这道谜题要求把下面那个词的字母重新排列，组成另一个词。

entries.en: Her interest in photojournalism grew during a student newspaper project.
entries.zh: 参加学生报纸项目期间，她对摄影新闻工作越来越感兴趣。

entries.en: They packed the fragile tableware in separate cardboard boxes.
entries.zh: 他们把易碎的餐具分别装进了纸箱。

entries.en: The obverse of the coin bears a ruler's portrait.
entries.zh: 这枚硬币的正面有一位统治者的肖像。

entries.en: The mutinous crew refused to follow the captain's orders.
entries.zh: 抗命的船员们拒绝遵从船长的命令。

entries.en: The villain's lackey carried out every order without question.
entries.zh: 反派的走卒对每一道命令都不加质疑地执行。

entries.en: A neutral organizer agreed to arbitrate the dispute between teams.
entries.zh: 一位中立的组织者同意仲裁两队之间的争端。

entries.en: The cartoon features a rotund chef with a towering hat.
entries.zh: 这部动画中有一位戴着高帽子的圆胖厨师。

entries.en: A damaged nib left uneven lines across the page.
entries.zh: 受损的钢笔尖在纸上留下了粗细不匀的线条。

entries.en: The speech sounded bombastic beside her simple, sincere remarks.
entries.zh: 与她朴实真诚的话相比，那篇演说显得夸夸其谈。

entries.en: The competition disqualified an entrant who had plagiarized a published story.
entries.zh: 比赛取消了一名参赛者的资格，因为他抄袭了已发表的故事。

entries.en: The huckster promised impossible results to anyone who bought his gadget.
entries.zh: 那个夸大叫卖的商贩向买他小玩意的人许诺不可能实现的效果。

entries.en: Tempestuous weather kept the fishing boats inside the harbor.
entries.zh: 猛烈的暴风雨使渔船都留在港内。

entries.en: The exhibition explores urbanism through photographs of shared public spaces.
entries.zh: 这次展览通过公共共享空间的照片探讨城市生活方式。

entries.en: The cartographer added newly surveyed islands to the map.
entries.zh: 制图师把新测绘的岛屿补到了地图上。

entries.en: An incorrigible daydreamer, he invented stories during every bus journey.
entries.zh: 他是个改不掉空想习惯的人，每次乘公交车都会编故事。

entries.en: Such petty insults are unbecoming of a team captain.
entries.zh: 这样的刻薄侮辱不符合队长应有的风度。

entries.en: The festival brought a rare moment of concord between rival villages.
entries.zh: 这次节庆让两个互相竞争的村庄有了难得的和睦时刻。

entries.en: The excited children jabbered about everything they had seen.
entries.zh: 兴奋的孩子们叽叽喳喳、含糊急促地说着所见的一切。

entries.en: A few gentle jokes leavened the otherwise solemn speech.
entries.zh: 几句温和的笑话给原本严肃的演说增添了趣味。

entries.en: The museum celebrates the island's long seafaring tradition.
entries.zh: 这家博物馆展现了岛上悠久的航海传统。

entries.en: We economized on space by choosing chairs that fold flat.
entries.zh: 我们选择了能完全折叠的椅子，以节省空间。

entries.en: A weekend bird survey sparked her interest in ornithology.
entries.zh: 一次周末鸟类调查激发了她对鸟类学的兴趣。

entries.en: The fictional mayor faced accusations of cronyism over committee appointments.
entries.zh: 这位虚构的市长因委员会任命问题而被指责任人唯亲。

entries.en: The biology exhibit shows vestigial wings on a flightless insect.
entries.zh: 生物展区展示了一种不会飞的昆虫身上退化残留的翅膀。

entries.en: The percussionist switched from a tambourine to a large drum.
entries.zh: 打击乐演奏者从铃鼓换到了大鼓。

entries.en: His brief dalliance with pottery produced three delightfully crooked bowls.
entries.zh: 他短暂尝试陶艺，做出了三只歪得可爱的碗。

entries.en: A stomachache kept the character away from the school picnic.
entries.zh: 故事中的人物因为肚子痛而没去参加学校野餐。

entries.en: An old map traces the watercourse through the valley.
entries.zh: 一张旧地图描出了穿过山谷的河道。

entries.en: From the plane, the island looked like a single dark landmass.
entries.zh: 从飞机上看，那座岛像一整片深色的陆地。

entries.en: The vintner arranged regional wines by the entrance to his shop.
entries.zh: 葡萄酒商把各地的葡萄酒摆在店门口。

entries.en: The truculent customer argued with every member of staff.
entries.zh: 那个好斗而粗暴的顾客跟每位员工都争吵。

entries.en: Our provident host had brought extra blankets for the cold evening.
entries.zh: 主人很有远虑，为寒冷的夜晚多带了几条毯子。

entries.en: An apostrophe marks the missing letter in this contraction.
entries.zh: 这个缩约形式用撇号标出省略的字母。

entries.en: His question was tangential to our main discussion about transport.
entries.zh: 他的问题与我们关于交通的主要讨论关系不大。

entries.en: The historical account describes land expropriated for a railway.
entries.zh: 这份历史记载描述了为修建铁路而被征用的土地。

entries.en: A little levity eased the tension before the results arrived.
entries.zh: 结果出来前，一点轻松诙谐缓和了紧张气氛。

entries.en: The library benefited from the largess of a local benefactor.
entries.zh: 这家图书馆受益于一位当地捐助者的慷慨赠予。

entries.en: The miser in the story refuses to replace his broken umbrella.
entries.zh: 故事中的吝啬鬼不肯换掉他的破雨伞。

entries.en: We sweltered in the crowded bus until the windows opened.
entries.zh: 在窗户打开之前，我们在拥挤的公交车里热得难受。

entries.en: She riffled through the notebook to find the missing address.
entries.zh: 她快速翻动笔记本，寻找不见了的地址。

entries.meaningZh: 幸运得仿佛天意安排的
entries.en: A providential cancellation left one room available for the stranded travelers.
entries.zh: 恰好有人取消了预订，仿佛天意般为滞留的旅客留下了一间房。

entries.en: He wheedled an extra biscuit out of his grandmother.
entries.zh: 他用甜言蜜语哄祖母多给了他一块饼干。

entries.en: Our teetotal host served sparkling apple juice at the celebration.
entries.zh: 滴酒不沾的主人在庆祝活动中提供了气泡苹果汁。

entries.en: The ceremonial sword rested in a richly decorated scabbard.
entries.zh: 礼仪用剑装在一只装饰华丽的剑鞘中。

entries.en: Diaphanous curtains moved gently in the evening breeze.
entries.zh: 轻薄透明的窗帘在晚风中轻轻摆动。

entries.en: Gusty weather made the paper lanterns swing wildly.
entries.zh: 强劲的阵风使纸灯笼猛烈地摇摆。

entries.en: The novel's malcontent complains about every change in the village.
entries.zh: 小说里那个不满现状的人对村庄的每一种变化都抱怨。

entries.en: The artist incised a flowing pattern into the clay bowl.
entries.zh: 艺术家在陶碗上刻出了流畅的图案。

entries.en: The basket maker selected young, pliant branches for the handle.
entries.zh: 编篮人挑选了柔韧的嫩枝来做提手。

entries.en: She retouched the photograph to remove a distracting background mark.
entries.zh: 她修饰了照片，去掉了背景中一处碍眼的痕迹。

entries.en: The novel introduces a notary who keeps meticulous records.
entries.zh: 小说中出现了一位记录十分细致的公证人。

entries.en: Bedlam erupted when the puppies escaped into the dining room.
entries.zh: 小狗们逃进餐厅后，那里顿时闹成了一团。

entries.en: The documentary follows an albino among a group of alligators.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片跟拍了一群短吻鳄中的一只白化个体。

entries.en: Each tile forms a hexagon with six equal sides.
entries.zh: 每块瓷砖都是六条边等长的六边形。

entries.en: A toothed wheel turned slowly inside the old clock.
entries.zh: 一个带齿的轮子在旧钟里缓缓转动。

entries.en: The museum label distinguishes fissile materials from other radioactive substances.
entries.zh: 博物馆的标签区分了可裂变材料与其他放射性物质。

entries.en: The bandleader raised a hand to signal the final chorus.
entries.zh: 乐队领队举手示意开始最后一段副歌。

entries.en: We rested on the leeward side of the stone wall.
entries.zh: 我们在石墙背风的一侧休息。

entries.en: Astronomy remained her favorite avocation throughout her teaching career.
entries.zh: 在整个教学生涯中，天文学始终是她最喜爱的业余爱好。

entries.en: The comedian avoided hoary jokes that everyone had heard before.
entries.zh: 喜剧演员没有讲那些人人都听过的陈腐笑话。

entries.en: The magazine published a satiric portrait of office life.
entries.zh: 这本杂志发表了一篇讽刺办公室生活的文章。

entries.en: The seminar explored hedonism as a theme in modern fiction.
entries.zh: 这次研讨会探讨了现代小说中的享乐主义主题。

entries.en: Too many simultaneous requests overtaxed the old computer.
entries.zh: 过多的同时请求使这台旧电脑不堪重负。

entries.en: The story examines the ostracism faced by a misunderstood newcomer.
entries.zh: 这个故事探讨了一位遭人误解的新来者所受到的排斥。

entries.en: An antique pressure gage stood beside the model steam engine.
entries.zh: 模型蒸汽机旁放着一只古老的压力表。

entries.en: The painting shows a reaper resting beside a sheaf of wheat.
entries.zh: 画中一位收割者正在一捆小麦旁休息。

entries.en: The forgotten lettuce leaves had become flaccid in the heat.
entries.zh: 那些被遗忘的生菜叶在高温中变得软塌塌的。

entries.en: The play treats its royal characters with cheerful irreverence.
entries.zh: 这出戏以轻松而不恭敬的态度描写王室人物。

entries.en: The archive contains the earliest existent copy of the poem.
entries.zh: 这座档案馆收藏着这首诗现存最早的抄本。

entries.en: A typo in the email sent us to the wrong room.
entries.zh: 邮件里的一处打字错误把我们带到了错误的房间。

entries.en: An inchoate idea slowly developed into a workable design.
entries.zh: 一个尚未成形的想法逐渐发展成了可行的设计。

entries.en: The lumberjack in the photograph stands beside an enormous stump.
entries.zh: 照片里的伐木工人站在一个巨大的树桩旁。

entries.en: The exquisite music ravished the hearts of the listeners.
entries.zh: 那美妙的音乐让听众心醉神迷。

entries.en: The anatomy model shows the aorta emerging from the heart.
entries.zh: 解剖模型显示了从心脏延伸出来的主动脉。
